# ai-v1_mcp_client (Data Source)





<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) name of the MCPClient

### Optional

- `hash` (String) resource content will be returned as it was at the time of this git hash

### Read-Only

- `alarms` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--alarms))
- `api_version` (String)
- `deviations` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--deviations))
- `kind` (String)
- `metadata` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--metadata))
- `spec` (Attributes) MCPClientSpec defines the desired state of MCPClient.

An MCPClient describes how EDA connects to a remote MCP server
over Streamable HTTP, how it authenticates, and which primitives
(tools, resources, prompts) it imports from that server. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--spec))
- `status` (Attributes) MCPClientStatus defines the observed state of an MCPClient. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--status))

<a id="nestedatt--spec"></a>
### Nested Schema for `spec`

Read-Only:

- `auth` (Attributes) Authentication configuration for the remote MCP server.
Exactly one of bearer or clientCredentials must be specified.
Only auth modes that can complete without human interaction are
supported, since MCPClient is applied declaratively via the API. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--spec--auth))
- `description` (String) A brief description of the remote MCP server.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether this remote MCP client connection is enabled.
When disabled, EDA will not connect to the remote server
and no primitives are imported.
- `endpoint` (Attributes) Endpoint configuration for reaching the remote MCP server. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--spec--endpoint))
- `imports` (Attributes) Imports controls which primitives advertised by the remote MCP
server are exposed through EDA's MCP surface. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--spec--imports))
- `title` (String) A human friendly title for the remote MCP server.

<a id="nestedatt--spec--auth"></a>
### Nested Schema for `spec.auth`

Read-Only:

- `bearer` (Attributes) Static bearer token / API key authentication.
The token is sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` on every
request to the remote MCP server. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--spec--auth--bearer))
- `client_credentials` (Attributes) OAuth 2.1 client_credentials flow (machine-to-machine).
EDA exchanges its client credentials for an access token at
the configured token endpoint and refreshes the token as
needed. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--spec--auth--client_credentials))

<a id="nestedatt--spec--auth--bearer"></a>
### Nested Schema for `spec.auth.bearer`

Read-Only:

- `key` (String) Key within the Secret's data map.
- `name` (String) Name of the Secret.


<a id="nestedatt--spec--auth--client_credentials"></a>
### Nested Schema for `spec.auth.client_credentials`

Read-Only:

- `audience` (String) Optional audience (`aud`) claim to request on the token.
- `client_auth_method` (String) How the client credentials are sent to the token endpoint.
- `client_id` (String) OAuth client identifier issued to EDA by the authorization server.
- `client_secret_ref` (Attributes) Reference to a Secret containing the OAuth client secret. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--spec--auth--client_credentials--client_secret_ref))
- `scopes` (List of String) OAuth scopes to request when obtaining an access token.
- `token_url` (String) Token endpoint URL of the OAuth authorization server.

<a id="nestedatt--spec--auth--client_credentials--client_secret_ref"></a>
### Nested Schema for `spec.auth.client_credentials.client_secret_ref`

Read-Only:

- `key` (String) Key within the Secret's data map.
- `name` (String) Name of the Secret.




<a id="nestedatt--spec--endpoint"></a>
### Nested Schema for `spec.endpoint`

Read-Only:

- `headers` (Attributes List) Additional HTTP headers to include on every request to the
remote MCP server. Headers carrying secrets should reference a
Kubernetes Secret via Auth instead of being set here. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--spec--endpoint--headers))
- `health_check_interval_seconds` (Number) Time between connection health checks (and re-discovery of
remote primitives) in seconds. Default 60 seconds.
- `skip_verify` (Boolean) InsecureSkipVerify disables TLS certificate validation when
connecting to the remote MCP server. Should only be used for
development. Defaults to false.
- `timeout_seconds` (Number) Per-request timeout in seconds for calls to the remote MCP
server. Default 30 seconds.
- `trust_bundle` (String) TrustBundle for TLS verification, a reference (by name) to a
ConfigMap containing one or more PEM-encoded CA certificates.
If empty, the system default trust bundle is used.
- `url` (String) URL of the remote MCP server's Streamable HTTP endpoint.
Includes scheme, host, port, and path.

<a id="nestedatt--spec--endpoint--headers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `spec.endpoint.headers`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) Header name
- `value` (String) Header value



<a id="nestedatt--spec--imports"></a>
### Nested Schema for `spec.imports`

Read-Only:

- `prompts` (Attributes) Prompt import configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--spec--imports--prompts))
- `resources` (Attributes) Resource import configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--spec--imports--resources))
- `tools` (Attributes) Tool import configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--spec--imports--tools))

<a id="nestedatt--spec--imports--prompts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `spec.imports.prompts`

Read-Only:

- `allow` (List of String) Allow list of primitive names. When non-empty, only listed
names are imported. Supports Regex matching.
Example:
- Allow: ["^route-lookup$"]
- Allow: ["route-lookup"]
- Allow: ["route-lookup.*"]
- Allow: ["route-lookup.*"]
- `deny` (List of String) Deny list of primitive names. Names listed here are excluded
even if they appear in Allow.
Supports Regex matching.
Example:
- Deny: ["^route-lookup$"]
- Deny: ["route-lookup"]
- Deny: ["route-lookup.*"]
- Deny: ["route-lookup.*"]
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether to import primitives of this kind.

<a id="nestedatt--status"></a>
### Nested Schema for `status`

Read-Only:

- `advertised_capabilities` (Attributes) AdvertisedCapabilities reports the capabilities the remote
MCP server advertised during `initialize`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--status--advertised_capabilities))
- `connected` (Boolean) Whether EDA is currently connected to the remote MCP server.
- `error` (String) Error message describing the most recent connection or
initialization failure. Empty when Connected is true.
- `imported_counts` (Attributes) ImportedCounts reports how many primitives of each kind are
currently imported into EDA's MCP surface. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--status--imported_counts))
- `last_checked` (String) Last time the connection to the remote MCP server was
validated.
- `server_info` (Attributes) ServerInfo reports the identity of the remote MCP server as
returned in its `initialize` response. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--status--server_info))

<a id="nestedatt--status--advertised_capabilities"></a>
### Nested Schema for `status.advertised_capabilities`

Read-Only:

- `completions` (Boolean) Whether the remote server exposes argument completions.
- `logging` (Boolean) Whether the remote server exposes the logging capability.
- `prompt_list_changed_notifications` (Boolean) Whether the remote server emits prompt list-changed
notifications.
- `prompts` (Boolean) Whether the remote server exposes prompts.
- `resource_list_changed_notifications` (Boolean) Whether the remote server emits resource list-changed
notifications.
- `resource_subscribe` (Boolean) Whether the remote server supports resource subscriptions.
- `resources` (Boolean) Whether the remote server exposes resources.
- `tool_list_changed_notifications` (Boolean) Whether the remote server emits tool list-changed
notifications.
- `tools` (Boolean) Whether the remote server exposes tools.

- `tools` (Number) Number of tools imported from the remote MCP server.
